purpose: Held-out evidence review; fictional. Review-only. Do not include this material in candidate inputs or publication-bound source packets.
material_findings: Prototype approval on 12 August is genuine and triggers the stage-two instalment; absence of final acceptance does not eliminate that adverse evidence.

Delivery on 31 August is supported, but the docket expressly qualifies receipt and contract separates delivery, prototype approval and final signed acceptance. Final acceptance or final instalment accrual is unverified.
4200 deposit cleared. The first 2100 cleared but was reallocated from this project to a disputed older invoice without a buyer instruction in the packet; its proper allocation needs reconciliation.
The second 2100 was reversed in full, so it must not be counted as a completed payment. Counting both August transfers as paid understates the issue.

If the first 2100 is applied to stage two, its residual is 2100; if the reallocation stands, it is 4200. Neither conditional illustration establishes the complete payable balance: opening credits and older account history are missing, and final milestone remains unverified.

The demand’s 8400 is its claimed project balance using deposit-only allocation; total 8850 adds 450. Arithmetic is coherent on that assumption, but assumptions and storage authorization lack verification.

Buyer has preliminary evidence of damage and requested inspection. The documents do not establish whether the planned 8 September inspection happened. Do not invent that it occurred or that Supplier definitely missed it.

17 September is a plausible five-business-day count if receipt were 10 September, but sending does not establish receipt: mail status was pending. Clause 9 instead states ten calendar days after receipt for response and joint review, without five-business-day payment acceleration. The demand’s asserted basis and deadline need verification.
An earlier credit is asserted, not proved. Do not invent its value, treat the project account export as complete, or assert a definitive final net balance.
verification_rationale: A sound review should trace cleared/reversed/reallocated transactions, preserve actual prototype approval, distinguish delivery from acceptance, give conditional arithmetic with limitations and identify the unresolved receipt and contractual basis for the demand deadline. Full-account reconciliation, bank allocation evidence, any credit note, acceptance/inspection evidence and notice-delivery evidence are material verification requests. No external legal conclusion is expected.
